name: Glassmorphism Lite
note: Frosted panels without the 2020 excess: periwinkle-violet seed at hue 230, cool-tinted neutrals, squircle intent (soft radii; corner-shape ships later), layered low-alpha shadows for floating panels, Sora's geometric voice, 0.04 grain to keep blur from banding. Don't stack more than two elevation layers and don't push opacity below the readable floor — glass lite stays legible first.
